goal: 把產品邊界轉成可直接支撐後續視覺設計的互動狀態，不決定最終 layout styling。

leftResourceNavigation.purpose: 找到、選中、重新找到一本 canonical Work。

entryStates.behavior: 標題、作者、主題、語言、關係與可用全文的統一搜尋；結果仍是 Work，不另開搜尋產品。
館藏分類與來源集合；只展示已有具體內容的集合。

entryStates.label: 三晨星
entryStates.behavior: 全站三晨星標準在黎明書局的館藏投影，只返回 Work。
使用者保存的 Work 與閱讀位置。
最近閱讀與可繼續閱讀的位置。

leftResourceNavigation.selection: 任何入口最終都產生 selectedWorkId + optional edition/source + optional reading locator/context，交給右側 workspace。
nonGoals: 不在左側承擔全文閱讀
不把光譜做成書局常駐模式
不把全站策展工具塞進左側

emptyState.purpose: 未選書時保持閱讀空間成立，而不是變成另一個首頁。
content: 最近一次閱讀可恢復提示
從左側選書的低干擾提示

loadingState.translation: 不阻塞原文先出現；翻譯可在原文可讀後按段/視窗逐步生成。

readyStates.behavior: 保持原文閱讀位置、章節與 source provenance。

readyStates.authority: machine reading translation; original remains authority
readyStates.behavior: 顯示繁中閱讀層；同一 segment identity 對應原文。
原文與繁中以 stable segment 對齊，不建立第二個 Work。

handoffs.siteThreeMorningStars: selected Work opens directly in Dawn Library workspace; three-star context may remain as discovery provenance.
handoffs.siteSpectrum: selected Work opens directly at the relevant Work/locator when available; Spectrum itself stays site-level.
handoffs.siteCuratedCollection: book item opens directly as canonical Work; collection context may remain as back/reference context.

responsivePrinciple.desktop: resource navigation and reading workspace may coexist.
responsivePrinciple.mobile: same state machine, not a different product; navigation may collapse/overlay, then yield full reading space after Work selection.
responsivePrinciple.rule: Responsive design may change spatial arrangement but must not change product hierarchy or duplicate capabilities.

designInvariant: 黎明書局任何視覺方案都必須首先讓『選一本書 → 立即閱讀/翻譯』成立；裝飾、動效與推薦不能打斷這條最短路徑。
next: Define Work/Edition/Reader information hierarchy inside the right workspace: what is always visible, what is secondary, and what only appears on demand.
